messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] physical position for QTL mapping.
parts:
The physical positions are useful for marker order, and you can make plots or calculate LOD support intervals in physical distance. But for QTL mapping we generally need genetic distances, in order to deal with missing genotype information.

Karl
